				<div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_5  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Earning Merit-Based Academic Scholarships at Manchester University</h2>
<p>Manchester offers renewable scholarships and grants to incoming students. We strongly believe that you have worked hard to earn your place in college and deserve financial assistance in the pursuit of your degree.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_6  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">WE BEGIN WITH ACADEMIC SCHOLARSHIPS</span></h3>
<p><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Each admitted student’s application is reviewed by hand. Academic scholarships are determined based on unweighted cumulative high school GPA. Merit scholarship awards range from <strong>$8,000 to $21,000 per year</strong>. </span></p>
<p><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Please work with your admission counselor to learn more about the scholarship opportunities available to you.</span></p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_3_5 et_pb_column_7  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_7 color-gold  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Indiana State Grants</h2>
<p><span>Indiana residents may qualify for financial aid programs administered by the </span><strong><span>Indiana Commission for Higher Education (ICHE)</span></strong>. These awards require that you file your FAFSA by April 15 of the spring before you intend to begin college courses. <a href="https://www.in.gov/che/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">The official state site</a> outlines your opportunities.</p>
<p>Don’t forget that your Manchester admissions counselor can help answer your questions.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_3_wrapper  et_pb_module ">
				<a class="et_pb_button et_pb_button_3 cta-link et_pb_bg_layout_light" href="https://www.in.gov/che/" target="_blank" data-icon="$">Find State Grants</a>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_divider et_pb_divider_0 et_pb_divider_position_ et_pb_space"><div class="et_pb_divider_internal"></div></div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_8 color-gold  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>21st Century Scholars</h2>
<p>If you are a 21st Century Scholar (you would have officially pledged so in seventh or eighth grade), Manchester is committed to helping you earn your degree. You’ll receive direct financial support from the state of Indiana, and in combination with other Manchester aid we seek to reduce annual expenses. <a href="https://scholars.in.gov/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">This site</a> describes the program, its opportunities and requirements.</p>
<p>If you have questions, your Manchester admissions counselor can guide you to answers.</p></div>

			</div><div id="Scholarship" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_9 lnadsc-img-rt-section et_pb_with_background et_section_regular" >
				
				
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_8">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_2_5 et_pb_column_11  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">

				<div class="et_pb_toggle et_pb_module et_pb_accordion_item et_pb_accordion_item_0  et_pb_toggle_open">
				
				
				
				
				<h3 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Honors & Presidential Scholarship</h3>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>High school seniors who are admitted to the University and awarded a Presidential Scholarship and apply for the Honors Program & attend Scholarship Day will be considered for our top academic scholarships. Though the final deadline for applying to the Honors Program is May 1, Presidential Scholarship recipients who apply by Sunday, Dec 1, are in the pool of candidates considered for these top scholarships.</p>
<p>One Honors Scholarship is awarded through the Scholarship Day Program, and it covers tuition, fees, room and board per year (for up to four years). The Honors Scholarship replaces the Presidential Scholarship. Honors Scholars must maintain a 3.5 CGPA, maintain active status in the Honors Program, and graduate with Honors & Achievement from the Honors Program.</p>
<p>All Presidential Scholars will be invited to Manchester University’s Scholarship Day on Saturday, Dec. 6 for a unique opportunity to interview with faculty and current students of the Honors Program to determine acceptance into the Honors Program and so that the Honors Committee can narrow down finalists and award the Honors and Trustee Scholarships. All applicants who attend will receive letters by mid-December on these decisions.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_toggle et_pb_module et_pb_accordion_item et_pb_accordion_item_1  et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h3 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Athletic Scholarship</h3>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><h3><span>60 Percent of Manchester Students are also Athletes</span></h3>
<p><span>In accordance with applicable rules, Manchester student-athletes enrolling Fall 2027 and beyond are eligible for athletic scholarships. Scholarship decisions will be made by the appropriate coaching staff and University representatives. While a roster opportunity and an athletic scholarship are separate decisions, prospective students are encouraged to connect with their coach and Manchester’s financial aid team to understand their individual options.</span></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_toggle et_pb_module et_pb_accordion_item et_pb_accordion_item_2  et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h3 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Trustee Scholarship</h3>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>Multiple Trustee Scholarships are awarded through the Scholarship Day Program, and they are up to $3,000 (for up to four years). The Trustee Scholarship <em>replaces</em> the Presidential Scholarship. Trustee Scholars must maintain a 3.5 CGPA, maintain active status in the Honors Program, and graduate with Honors from the Honors Program.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_toggle et_pb_module et_pb_accordion_item et_pb_accordion_item_3  et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h3 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Esports Scholarship</h3>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>Students who are members of the Manchester University Esports team are evaluated for this scholarship.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_toggle et_pb_module et_pb_accordion_item et_pb_accordion_item_4  et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h3 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Music Scholarship</h3>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>Students who participate in a Manchester University music ensemble are evaluated for this scholarship.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_toggle et_pb_module et_pb_accordion_item et_pb_accordion_item_5  et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h3 class="et_pb_toggle_title">MU Grant</h3>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>Manchester aid awarded to students based on financial need (as determined by the FAFSA).</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_toggle et_pb_module et_pb_accordion_item et_pb_accordion_item_6  et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h3 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Matching Programs</h3>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><strong>Dollars for Scholars Match</strong> – up to $500 per year</p>
<ul>
<li>Matching program awarded to students who receive a Dollars for Scholars award.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Church Scholarship Match</strong> – up to $500 per year</p>
<ul>
<li>Matching program awarded to students who receive a church scholarship.</li>
<li>Church must be part of the Church Matching Program for a student to receive the match. </li>
<li>Not all scholarships awarded by a church are part of the matching program.</li>
</ul></div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Where can I Find Scholarships Near Me?</h2>
<h3><strong>Think Local</strong></h3>
<p>Speak with your high school guidance office. Talk with employers and small businesses. Folks near your home know well the awards that have served previous students.</p>
<h3>Utilize Community Foundations</h3>
<p><a href="https://www.cof.org/locator" target="_blank" rel="noopener">This map</a> will help you find yours. Just remember, a community foundation is a local organization that manages charitable funds and awards grants and scholarships to support people, organizations and causes. But in your case, they also support students from a specific community or region.</p>
<h3>Take Advantage of Manchester’s Experience.</h3>
<p>We collect and post scholarship opportunities on our <a href="https://www.pinterest.com/manchesteru/scholarship-opportunities/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Pinterest board</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Popular online databases:</strong></p>

<style id="divibar-guard">
  /* Default: lock header at 40px unless we explicitly opt-in to 110 */
  html:not(.divibar-force-110) #global-header-section { padding-top: 40px !important; }

  html.divibar-force-110 #global-header-section { padding-top: 110px !important; }

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- Config ---
  const HEADER_ID = 'global-header-section';
  const CANDS = '.divibars-container, .divibars, .divibars-wrapper, .divibars-content, [class*="divibar"]';

  // --- 0) First-paint lock: set 40px inline ASAP, even before <body> exists ---
  (function ensure40pxInlineEarly() {
    function set40(el) { el && el.style.setProperty('padding-top', '40px', 'important'); }

    if (hdrNow) { set40(hdrNow); return; }

      const hdr = document.getElementById(HEADER_ID);

  })();

  // --- Helpers ---
  function hideDiviBars() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.divibars-container').forEach(div => {
      const content = (div.textContent || '').replace(/\u00A0/g, ' ').trim();

        !content ||
        /all\s*clear/i.test(content) ||
        /test/i.test(content) ||
        /feed\s*has\s*no\s*items\.?/i.test(content);
      if (shouldHide) div.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
    });
  }

    if (!el || !el.isConnected) return false;
    const target = el.querySelector('.divibars, .divibars-wrapper, .divibars-content') || el;
    const cs = getComputedStyle(target);
    if (cs.display === 'none' || cs.visibility === 'hidden' || target.hidden) return false;

    const vh = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
    return rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < vh;
  }

  function anyRealBannerVisible() {
    // A “real” banner = visible AND not empty/test/all-clear/feed-empty
    return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(CANDS)).some(el => {
      if (!isEffectivelyVisible(el)) return false;
      const txt = (el.textContent || '').replace(/\u00A0/g, ' ').trim();
      if (!txt) return false;
      if (/all\s*clear/i.test(txt) || /test/i.test(txt) || /feed\s*has\s*no\s*items\.?/i.test(txt)) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }

  function setForce110(on) {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const was = root.classList.contains('divibar-force-110');
    if (!!on === was) return;
    root.classList.add('divibar-atomic');
    root.classList.toggle('divibar-force-110', !!on);

    if (raf1) return;

      raf1 = null;
      hideDiviBars();
      const a = anyRealBannerVisible();
      raf2 = requestAnimationFrame(() => {

    const btn = e.target && e.target.closest('.divibars-close');
    if (!btn) return;
    setTimeout(() => {
      const bar = btn.closest('.divibars-container, [class*="divibar"]');
      if (bar) bar.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
      scheduleRecompute();
    }, 200);
  }, true);

  // Initial pass
  scheduleRecompute();
})();
